summary: Valley County, ID summit lookout with an L-4 cab, built 1930 and destroyed 1952. A 1966 survey note mentions its foundation; no recent description found.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1952. A 1966 survey note mentions an old lookout foundation; no recent description found.

access.note: Summit reached by a long hike on a trail described in a 2018 climbing guide; no closure found in the sources read

visit.trail_note: Long trail hike from the East Fork South Fork Salmon River (climbing guide, updated July 2018); the 1966 survey route used Elk Summit Road and the West Fork of Elk Creek

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey station description says the summit marker is surrounded by the foundation of an old lookout house

notes_for_editor: Built 1930 and destroyed 1952 agree across sources. The 1966 survey description is the last source found about the site, and no current description was found. Elevation differs: Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 8833 ft, the 1966 survey gives 8822 ft; elevation is not a record field, so it is not used. Staffing is undocumented. Public access is inferred from the 2018 climbing guide's trail description. The 1966 route and the 2018 guide name different approaches; the story does not reconcile them.
